BIOL 210 Course Agenda

Week 1, Aug 26-28

agenda-week1.Rmd

Reminders

  • Please complete the Getting to Know You form by Sun Aug 30.

  • BIOL 211 Lab will begin next week, Tue Sep 1 and Wed Sep 2. Lab meets in K119.

  • The first problem set is available and is due Sun Aug 30. You will also want to watch the week 1 content videos (see agenda week 1).

  • Quiz 1 will be Fri Sep 4, at the same time as Quiz 2. You will take the quiz in class and then teams will work together on revisions in class.

Content Videos

  • 01-Biodiversity

  • 02-Phylogenies

  • 03-Cells

Assignments

Problem Set 1 is due Sun Aug 30. It is beneficial for you to complete the content videos and begin assignments before the week of class.

The first quiz will not occur until the end of week 2 but it will cover both week 1 and week 2 material.

Class Meetings

Wednesday Aug 26

  • First day of class – go over syllabus, teaching philosophy, course expectations.

  • Link to slides Requires you to log into your Oberlin account to access.

  • Please fill out the Getting to Know You form before Sat 8/30.

  • Note: I recommend you watch the videos for next week before Wed 9/2 (see Week 2 agenda).

Friday Aug 28

Begin case study “A Tale of Three Lice”.
